title: Intro
objectives: []
---

A normal block that is NOT valid Python 3.8 (dict union, added in 3.9) — this must fail
check:python since it isn't marked `bad38`:

```python
a = {"x": 1}
b = {"y": 2}
c = a | b
print(c)
```

A `bad38` block that is actually valid Python 3.8 — this must also fail check:python, since a
`bad38` block that passes cleanly is itself an error (plan §4.5):

```python bad38
print("this is fine on 3.8")
```
